name: B10-0377/2025 (Renew) – Case of Abdoul Aziz Goma, arbitrarily detained in Togo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Abdoul Aziz Goma, arbitrarily detained in Togo
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Abdoul Aziz Goma, an Irish-Togolese businessman held in Togo since 2018. The United Nations found his detention had no legal basis. In February 2025 he was sentenced to ten years in prison after a one-day trial. He says he has been tortured and denied medical care, and he began a hunger strike in August 2025. The Parliament asks Togo to free him and give him medical treatment, lawyers and family visits.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and request, not a decision.
- **Who it affects:** Abdoul Aziz Goma, held in Togo, and other political prisoners there.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU bodies and Togolese authorities, who are asked to act.
